```python
def test_fib():
    # Base cases
    assert fib(0) == 0
    assert fib(1) == 1

    # Standard Fibonacci values
    assert fib(2) == 1
    assert fib(3) == 2
    assert fib(4) == 3
    assert fib(5) == 5
    assert fib(6) == 8
    assert fib(7) == 13
    assert fib(10) == 55
    assert fib(15) == 610
    assert fib(20) == 6765

    # Verify a few values against an iterative reference
    def fib_iter(n):
        a, b = 0, 1
        for _ in range(n):
            a, b = b, a + b
        return a

    for n in range(0, 15):
        assert fib(n) == fib_iter(n), f"Mismatch at n={n}"

    print("All fib tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_fib()
```
